items.prompt: A box holds 5 cards labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Two cards are drawn one at a time without replacement. What is the probability that both cards show an odd number? (Odd numbers: 1, 3, 5.)
A game pays $8 if a fair coin lands heads and $0 if it lands tails. Each play costs $3. What is the expected net gain per play?
A lottery ticket wins $50 with probability 1/20 and wins nothing otherwise. What is the expected value of the winnings from one ticket?
A spinner has 5 equally sized sectors numbered 1 through 5. Event A: the result is odd. Event B: the result is greater than 3. Are A and B independent? P(A)=3/5, P(B)=2/5, P(A and B)=1/5.

choices.A: Yes, because P(A and B) = P(A)·P(B)
choices.C: Yes, because A and B share no outcomes
choices.D: No, because P(A and B) ≠ P(A)·P(B)

items.prompt: A standard six-sided die (faces 1–6) is rolled once. Given that the result is even, what is the probability that it is greater than 2?
